text.title: Parents who order groceries online: 12 interviews, May 2026
text.who: Olga, 34, marketing manager, two kids, evening commute
text.need_to_do: plan the family week, choose a slot, know the order will be on time
text.see: rival apps with cheap offers; friends posting about fresh deliveries
text.say: «I never know if the slot will be on time»
text.do: checks the app 5 times a day; calls support when late
text.hear: friends recommend cheaper rivals; news about courier shortages
text.pains: late deliveries, missed items, wasted evenings
text.gains: time for family, fresh food, peace of mind
text.think_feel: wants a weekly plan she does not have to check
text.decision: add a delivery-time guarantee to the slot picker; product lead decides
text.result: guarantee shown in the slot picker from 1 July; complaints checked after 4 weeks
